summary: VersaBank filed a 6-K reporting shareholder approval of a reorganization in which Versa Bancorp, a new Delaware corporation, becomes the direct holding company of the Bank. At the September 16, 2026 special meeting, 21,915,383 of 21,981,591 shares voted, or 99.69%, backed the resolution, exceeding the 66 2/3% threshold. Completion is targeted by end-October 2026, subject to Minister of Finance (Canada) and Federal Reserve Board approvals. The structure is a US-equivalent holding-company reorganization rather than a sale; watch regulatory timing and any dissent or appraisal risk.
